Create a new hitoami autumn/winter seasonal yarn hero photograph, landscape 3:2, 1536 x 1024. Generous negative space. Quiet Japanese autumn editorial still life, strong unmistakable autumn/winter palette with restrained natural saturation, neutral cream white balance, no orange filter.

1. Main focal yarn at about x=72%, y=69%, a compact realistically wound low cylindrical cake of 油画圈圈线 oil-painting boucle yarn, its spiral top visible from above. Photographic tactile detail, soft uniform lighting, short understated shadows identical in character to C1/C2. All objects in focus, strict top-down flat lay, no horizon, no shallow depth of field.
